##### Project general facts

1CTRL, developed by Object 1, is a lifestyle-led residential tower built around a clear concept of modes of living that connect wellness, creativity, family life and social spaces. Its contemporary architecture pairs clean white facades with glazed balconies and planted edges, while the interiors hold a selection of one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments designed for everyday comfort.

Residents move between a gym with AI trainer displays, a yoga zone, a meditation zone and a dedicated running track, with a sauna offering separate areas for men and women. Creative and social life unfolds in a podcast studio and a rooftop terrace garden, joined by a swimming pool with open skyline views. Families are served by an indoor kids play room, an outdoor kids area and a separate kids pool.

Apartments feature warm neutral palettes, natural textures and generous windows that draw daylight into the living spaces, with private balconies extending each home outdoors. Residences come partly furnished, giving owners a ready base with room to add personal pieces.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Land Residence Complex is a residential community in the Dubailand area, positioned beside the tech district across Al Ain Road and close to Dubai Silicon Oasis. Direct connections to Al Ain Road and Emirates Road link the neighbourhood with Downtown Dubai, Business Bay and Dubai International Airport.

Supermarkets, nurseries and clinics sit inside the community, while British-curriculum schools such as The Aquila School and GEMS FirstPoint are nearby. Global Village and Dubai Outlet Mall are within easy driving reach for leisure and shopping, and Sheikh Zayed bin Hamdan Al Nahyan Street adds another route across the city.

Rental demand draws on employees of the Dubai Silicon Oasis tech cluster, students and staff of Academic City, and middle-income families who value affordability and nearby schools. This mix positions the community as a practical choice for both end users and investors seeking steady tenant interest.
